title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Supine adult male from above, head at the top, the patient's right on the image left, arms adducted at the sides.
teachingPoint: Probe sagittal in the infraclavicular fossa; needle in just above (behind) the clavicle, directly cranial to the probe, aimed caudally, strictly in-plane.
claims: Supine, arm adducted (record); patient's right on the image left; reuses the approved decompression torso layout.

Linear probe standing upright, sagittal, in the right infraclavicular fossa below the lateral third of the clavicle; handle drawn foreshortened toward the feet (record: sagittal over the infraclavicular fossa).
Needle entering just above the clavicle, directly cranial to the probe and in line with it, aimed caudally (record: posterior to the clavicle, caudal, strictly in-plane).
Labels: Clavicle, Linear probe, Block needle.
